column3: NASB supplies “Go up”; “an obstinate people” renders “a people stiff of neck.”
“should I go up … I would destroy you” renders “one moment I will go up … and make an end of you”; “know” renders “consider.”
NASB supplies “onward”; the sense of “from Mount Horeb” is uncertain.
NASB uses the customary “used to take” for the Hebrew verb.
NASB supplies “the LORD” as subject of “would speak.”
“My presence” renders “my face (panim),” and NASB adds “with you.”
“cover you with My hand” renders “screen you with my palm.”
